[[File:Dozer.png|thumb|250px|Dozer]] '''Dozer''' (Japanese: '''ゲンバ''' ''Genba'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[JN051|Trials of a Budding Master!]]''. Dozer met {{Ash}} and [[Goh]] while they were investigating a [[mass outbreak]] of {{p|Geodude}} at the [[Rock Tunnel]]. Ash received word that Dozer was a challenger in the [[World Coronation Series]]. As a result, he challenged him to a {{pkmn|battle}}, which he accepted. Dozer used his {{p|Gurdurr}} against [[Ash's Farfetch'd]], and after a tough match, Farfetch'd's {{m|Brutal Swing}} was able to smash through Gurdurr's girder. Gurdurr was subsequently knocked out, causing Dozer's ranking to go down. Dozer comforted Gurdurr afterwards and gave it his pickaxe and watched as Farfetch'd ran off. ==Pokémon== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Dozer |pkmn=Gurdurr |type1=Fighting |img=Dozer Gurdurr.png |epnum=JN051 |epname=Trials of a Budding Master! |vajp=Yasuhiro Mamiya |vaen=Bill Rogers |desc={{p|Gurdurr}} is Dozer's only known Pokémon. He used it in a [[World Coronation Series]] match against {{Ash}}, where it went up against his {{AP|Farfetch'd}}. It was defeated when Farfetch'd's {{m|Brutal Swing}} smashed through its girder. Gurdurr became upset over this, but it accepted Dozer's pickaxe as a temporary replacement.
